title: Act
description: Schema for an Act in the Open Laws India corpus

act_id.description: Legacy canonical Act ID e.g. A1860-45 (kept as an alias of work_id)

work_id.description: Jurisdiction-qualified work ID {jurisdiction}/{doc_type}/{year}/{number} e.g. in-central/act/1860/45 (no zero-padding)

title.description: Full formal title of the Act

act_number.description: Official Act number e.g. ACT NO. 45 OF 1860

enactment_date.description: Date of enactment as published in the preamble (raw, e.g. [27th March, 1855.])

assent_date.description: ISO 8601 date of assent parsed from enactment_date; null when unparseable

commencement_date.description: ISO 8601 date the Act came into force; null when unknown (always null in v0.2.0)

repeal_date.description: ISO 8601 date the repeal took effect, parsed from repeal_reason; null if in force

savings_clause.description: Savings provision in the repealing Act, e.g. BNS s. 358; null if none

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code (IN-CENTRAL or ISO state code e.g. IN-MH)
